$description: Atelier design tokens (DTCG), rebranded for Qatar Islamic Bank (qib.com.qa) for the Jahiz prototype, 8 Oct 2026. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — edit here only; never hand-edit src/index.css or src/generated/tokens.tsx. Palette read from the computed :root tokens of qib.com.qa: --Color-Buttons-Primary-Rest #0075B0, --Color-Surface-Background-darkBlue #002E5E, --Color-Text-Base1 #00111A, --Color-Buttons-Tertiary-Rest #DF7A00 (orange), --Color-Text-Hyperlink #00A1DE, --Color-Surface-Background-Private #2F3D4B / --Color-Private-Secondary #831A4B, --Color-Surface-Background-Grey #F4F4F4; fonts Open Sans + Almarai. Backgrounds kept quiet (Rafeeq feedback): the brand blue lives on fills and ink, not on the page. REBRANDING CONTRACT: a client rebrand changes ONLY color.light, color.dark, the brand block, typography.fontFamily and the asset files in public/brand/.

primary.$description: QIB primary blue #0075B0 (--Color-Buttons-Primary-Rest); white on it clears 4.5:1.

accent.$description: QIB orange #DF7A00 deepened to clear 4.5:1 on white; hue preserved.

chart1.$description: Categorical series colour, slot 1 of a fixed five, assigned in this order and never cycled. Blue and violet are not adjacent.

primary.$description: QIB light blue 600 #4CBDE8 (--Color-Secondary-Light-Blue-Light-Blue-600) for ink on the dark theme.

sans.$description: Body, tables, figures: Inter for Latin (tabular numerals). Alexandria as the fallback carries every Arabic glyph, since Inter has no Arabic.

serif.$description: Atelier's --font-serif is the heading/display face. Alexandria is the typeface tasama.com.sa sets its whole site in — a geometric sans drawn for Arabic and Latin together, which matches the wordmark's construction. Covers Arabic as well.

mono.$description: Eyebrows, section labels, references, telemetry chips.

wordmark.$description: The product wordmark in the title bar, set in Tasama's own face.

brand.$description: The QIB brand layer: signature gradient, highlight, status hues, backdrop stops, wallpaper art and the hero dark island.

gradient.$description: Four stops of the signature accent gradient: QIB dark blue → primary blue → hyperlink light blue → orange.

highlight.$description: QIB hyperlink blue (#00A1DE) family for interactive affordances; deepened for contrast on light.

wash.$description: The brand colour verbatim. A fill, not a text colour — 1.6:1 on white.

light.$description: Deepened to clear 4.5:1 on both white and the light background; hue preserved at 93°.

dark.$description: On the dark background the brand colour is legible as drawn — 12.4:1 — so it is used exactly as TASAMA draws it.

status.$description: Status is not brand. Green, amber and red stay recognisable even though none of them is a Tasama colour.

backdrop.$description: 160deg backdrop stops, shown while the wallpaper loads. Kept within a few points of the page background so nothing reads as a colour field.

backdropArtOpacity.$description: Opacity of the wallpaper layer per theme. Both artworks are quiet (greyscale spread under 20), so both run at full strength.

hero.$description: The .page-hero dark island in both themes: QIB dark blue #002E5E carrying QIB orange #DF7A00 as its accent (5.6:1 on the navy).
